map.影响成活率的关键是什么？: What is the key factor affecting survival rate?
map.主要是密度、水温、运输时长和溶氧。密度越高、温度越高、时间越长，代谢与耗氧越大，: Mainly density, water temperature, transport duration and dissolved oxygen. Higher density, higher temperature and longer time all increase metabolism and oxygen consumption, lowering the survival rate.
